summary: This May 2024 Iran Trap lecture is already public support for Iran As Pressure Point and Game Theory; its remaining pressure is forecast-family discipline around invasion-as-hostage-trap, nuclear-threat exit logic, China shipbuilding, and player-specific war payoffs.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: A move against Iran does not stay local: it turns invasion logic, terrain, alliance payoffs, regime-change pressure, and American exit cost into one systems test.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Iran page already uses this source as the original trap layer for Iran becoming a pressure point across invasion, Gulf protection, Hormuz, Treasury demand, alliance trust, and dollar belief. No episode read JSON link is changed in this intake.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang's May 2024 two-to-four-year Iran-war scenario is speculative model work and should be split before ledger promotion.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Prediction owns the source date, horizon, exact scenario objects, later comparison, and falsifier trail. This source should feed active-watch comparison, not immediate one-item ledger scoring.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the original Iran Trap layer for Iran as a pressure point. Jiang's speculative invasion scenario turns the apparent victory image into a trap where troops become hostages, where terrain and supply lines matter more than spectacle, and where each regional actor may want the same invasion for different reasons.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Iran As Pressure Point owns transmission across invasion, terrain, alliance payoffs, Hormuz-adjacent exit cost, and dollar-order pressure. Chokepoint owns straits and access-control mechanics; No-Exit War owns escalation-ladder and mission-creep mechanics; Prediction owns dated forecast scoring.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the method case where historical analogy and game theory explain why rational players might want a war that looks stupid from outside. The United States wants regime change, Iran wants the invasion on terrain it can control, and Israel, Saudi Arabia, Russia, and China may each imagine different payoffs inside the same catastrophe.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Game Theory owns player payoffs and why apparent irrationality can be rational inside another actor's game. Strategy owns whether the game passes the material war test; Prediction owns the dated scenario status.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the source as an early invasion-trap ancestor for no-exit war: observers become advisors, advisors become trainers, trainers become soldiers, and sunk cost turns a bad expedition into a black hole.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: No-Exit War receives the source only where the active mechanism is mission creep, sunk cost, trapped forces, and exit cost. Iran As Pressure Point remains the wider system-transmission home.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the source as a 2024 spectacle-versus-material ancestor: shock and awe, carrier spectacle, and televised victory hide the older tests of mass, supply lines, terrain, public consent, and enemy adaptation.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Strategy owns the material audit and spectacle correction. Game Theory owns the multi-actor payoff map; Iran As Pressure Point owns the Iran-specific transmission surface.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Queue the dated forecast family rather than promote it: the May 29, 2024 lecture forecasts or models a two-to-four-year war path, Operation Iranian Freedom, an invasion that turns troops into hostages, a nuclear-threat exit problem, and a China shipbuilding constraint.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Prediction owns source date, exact forecast object, horizon, later event comparison, and falsifier path. Do not merge this into later March-April 2026 active-watch branches without preserving the earlier 2024 formulation.

chronology_notes.note: On 2024-05-29 Jiang gives the original Iran Trap formulation: a war that appears as American domination can become an Iran pressure point because the invasion force, terrain, supply, regional payoffs, and exit cost turn victory imagery into hostage logic.
The lecture is an early public method case for Jiang's player-payoff analysis: apparently irrational invasion pressure becomes legible when each actor wants a different outcome from the same war.

The two-to-four-year Iran-war scenario is dated to 2024-05-29 and should remain split from later 2025 and 2026 Iran-war active-watch branches unless a ledger comparison explicitly tracks continuity, revision, and miss/hit status.

canon_candidates.candidate: On 2024-05-29 Jiang says the United States is looking for a reason and Iran wants to give it one, then dates a possible two-to-four-year Iran-war path from that lecture.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Compare with later 2025 and March-April 2026 Iran-war records; keep war trigger, U.S. ground invasion, Iran trap, and allied payoff branches separate before any ledger promotion.

canon_candidates.candidate: The speculative Operation Iranian Freedom scenario models a full-scale invasion framed as democracy, nuclear prevention, shipping security, ally defense, and counterterrorism, but treats the invasion force as trapped hostages once it enters Iran.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Do not promote as one prediction. Split war pretext, ground invasion, occupation feasibility, hostage-trap mechanics, and later actual-event status.

canon_candidates.candidate: Jiang says the exit from the Iran trap could become a nuclear-threat problem: America might threaten nuclear use to force safe passage, while China could outbuild American naval replacement capacity.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Compare with later no-nuclear-use, naval capacity, China, and escalation-ladder branches; keep nuclear coercion distinct from later claims that Israel or America will not use nuclear weapons.

next_actions.action: No public Iran or Game Theory append is needed now: the public Iran page already cites this source for the original trap-to-pressure-point mechanism, and Game Theory already cites it for multi-actor payoff analysis.

If provenance maintenance follows, consider a narrow episode-to-lens link batch from the read's hostage-trap and multi-actor-payoff marks to `lens-point:iran-pressure-transmits-across-systems`; keep that separate from this workflow-only intake.

If Prediction work follows, compare this 2024 two-to-four-year Iran-war scenario against the June 2025 war-incoming update, the March-April 2026 active-watch synthesis, and later event status; split ground invasion, nuclear coercion, China shipbuilding, and actor-payoff branches before scoring.

Do not create standalone Iran Trap, Operation Iranian Freedom, Shock And Awe, Troops As Hostages, Nuclear Exit Threat, China Builds 232 Ships, Sicily Expedition, Vietnam Quagmire, or Putin Lets America Drown pages from this source alone.
